moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio depth-zoom, written here): Card scales about its centre 0.15 → 1.35 (ends larger than its layout size), blur 6 → 0 px and opacity 0.2 → 1, together in 740 ms power4.inOut (easeInOutQuint). Site: fade in over the first 250 ms of the loop; exit fade 300 ms power2.in. Perspective guide lines are not ported. Params: duration (0.74 s) · scale (0.15 → 1.35) · blur (6 px) · ease (power4.inOut).
